name: Noise Field Generator
aliases: Noise Field Generator — Layered Simplex Noise with Gradient, SimplexNoise3D
definition: Generates a 3D scalar field using layered Simplex noise, offset by a linear vertical gradient.
summary: The Noise Field Generator creates 3D scalar fields using layered Simplex noise with vertical gradients, offering directional consistency and animation support for volumetric texture synthesis.
